skill.name: supabase
skill.description: Manage Supabase projects, databases, migrations, Edge Functions, storage, and secrets with CLI-oriented workflows.
skill.summary: CLI workflow guidance for Supabase project, database, function, storage, secret, and type generation tasks.
skill.author: Dicklesworthstone

security_audit.summary: The static backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting and fenced bash examples. No prompt injection or malicious code was found. The skill still needs confirmation guidance because it documents Supabase commands that can change remote databases, functions, storage, and secrets.

remediation.issue: Remote and destructive Supabase operations lack explicit confirmation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require the agent to confirm project reference, environment, command intent, and user approval before db push, db reset, function deploy, storage copy, or secret changes.

remediation.issue: Read-only and write-capable workflows are mixed together.
remediation.suggestion: Separate safe inspection commands from commands that modify databases, deployments, storage, or secrets.

remediation.issue: Secret management workflows do not warn against exposing secret values.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to avoid placing secret values in prompts, logs, generated files, or shared transcripts.

content.user_title: Manage Supabase Projects with CLI Workflows
content.value_statement: Supabase teams need repeatable commands for projects, schemas, functions, storage, and secrets. This skill organizes common CLI workflows for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: List and link Supabase projects using documented CLI workflows.
Start, stop, and inspect local Supabase development services.
Run database queries, pull schemas, push migrations, reset local databases, and compare schema differences.
Create, list, apply, and squash Supabase migrations.
Create, deploy, serve, and inspect Supabase Edge Functions.
Manage storage paths, Edge Function secrets, type generation, and CLI login steps.
limitations: Requires the Supabase CLI to be installed and authenticated outside the skill.
Does not validate project references, migration safety, or SQL correctness.
Includes workflows that can modify remote services when a project is linked.
Does not replace Supabase documentation or production deployment review.

use_cases.title: Set Up Local Development
use_cases.description: Prepare local Supabase services and inspect their status before feature work.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Schema Changes
use_cases.description: Create migrations, compare schemas, and plan database updates before applying changes.

use_cases.title: Deploy Platform Updates
use_cases.description: Manage Edge Functions, storage paths, and secrets with clear CLI steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Local Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me check whether my local Supabase stack is running and list the next safe setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating a Supabase migration, reviewing the schema diff, and preparing a safe apply plan.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy an Edge Function
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare a Supabase Edge Function deployment with project confirmation, local serving, logs review, and rollback notes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Remote Change Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Supabase release workflow for database, function, storage, and secret changes. Identify confirmation gates and risky steps.

output_examples.input: I need to prepare a local Supabase development environment.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering CLI authentication, local stack startup, service status, schema sync, and safe next actions.

output_examples.input: I want to deploy an Edge Function safely.
output_examples.output: A deployment plan with project confirmation, local serving, deployment steps, log review, and rollback considerations.

output_examples.input: I need to update database types for my application.
output_examples.output: A workflow for choosing local or remote type generation, confirming the project, and reviewing generated files.

best_practices: Confirm the project reference and environment before any remote operation.
Use read-only checks before migration, storage, secret, or deployment changes.
Keep secret values out of prompts, terminal logs, and shared transcripts.
anti_patterns: Running remote writes without confirming the target project.
Resetting databases before checking backups and environment scope.
Asking the agent to reveal, paste, or store secret values.

faq.question: Does this skill run Supabase commands by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides CLI workflows for AI tools that may run commands only when the user allows tool execution.

faq.question: Do I need the Supabase CLI installed?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows assume the Supabase CLI is installed and available in the project environment.

faq.question: Can it manage Edge Functions?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers listing, creating, deploying, serving, and reviewing logs for Supabase Edge Functions.

faq.question: Can it handle Supabase secrets?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes secret set, list, and unset workflows, but secret values should not be exposed in chat.

faq.question: Does it create database migrations?
faq.answer: It guides migration creation, listing, applying, and squashing. Users should review migrations before applying them.

faq.question: Is it safe for production projects?
faq.answer: Use production workflows with explicit confirmation, backups, and review. Several commands can change remote resources.
